data.gender_notes: Orin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Orin was a god of the mountains and a hunter. His name derives from the Greek word oros, meaning 'mountain'. In Christian context, Orin can be seen as a symbol of strength and endurance, representing the spiritual journey up the mountain of life. The name Orin carries the meaning “Light, mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Orin usually hope their child will grow to embody light, mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
